evidence.content: Hi Drew, I need to turn the following policy into a schedule with owners and review dates. The work packet specifies record types: support tickets and billing records, a default retention of 3 years, and owner: Records Operations. Could you advise on how to structure the schedule and whether Records Operations should own both record types, or if different owners are appropriate? Also, what review cycle would you recommend for this retention schedule?
The records archivist recommends adding a quarterly review date for exceptions so schedule owners can catch policy changes; the current three-year rule is complete for this task.
